claim: Conformal Structured Prediction (Bastani group) proves coverage guarantees for prediction sets represented implicitly as compact structured objects (e.g. DAG nodes), avoiding exponential enumeration of labels in structured-output tasks like text generation.
stance_target: existence of general theoretical machinery for structured/hierarchical conformal coverage that could be adapted to per-requirement decomposition
scope_conditions: general structured prediction (text generation, hierarchical image labels); not code-specific, not applied to execution-checkable sub-claims
quoted_support: we propose a general framework for conformal prediction in the structured prediction setting, that modifies existing conformal prediction algorithms to output structured prediction sets that implicitly represent sets of labels
